Ancient technology makes it possible to enhance cutting power beyond metal weapons' limits.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 60 |durability = 25 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Battle Axe++}} Ancient Battle Axes++ are [[Weapon]]s used by [[Guardian Scout IV|Guardian Scouts IV]] in "A Major Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. They also have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s spawned by scanning the {{BotW|-}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. They are [[Ancient Battle Axe]]s that have been enhanced with [[Ancient Technology]] to reach peak performance, beyond the limits of metal weaponry. Due to Ancient Battle Axes++ being made of Ancient Technology, they will deal additional damage if they are used against Guardians. They will not burn when exposed to a [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]]. However, they are unable to be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. They float when dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Ancient Battle Axes++ belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, a collection of Weapons that are wielded by [[Guardian Scout]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_015" |Life = 25 |Power = 60 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon";
